rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿００４I thought someone was still￥here. So it's you.＝＠１４７＿００５You've been training this late?￥You're working really hard.＝＠１４７＿００６With that much training, you￥must be able to feel yourself￥getting better.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿００７Well? Say you qualify and￥go to Elan...＝＠１４７＿００８Are you confident you can handle￥the work properly?
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１０You're not...?＝＠１４７＿０１１From what I can see, your￥training is paying off fine.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１２With that attitude, you'll never￥show what you can really do!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１３Have more faith in yourself. You￥haven't been training all this￥time for nothing.＝＠１４７＿０１４What you're learning now will be￥useful once you're on Elan.￥I guarantee it.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１５You need to have more confidence￥in yourself.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１６Now, get some rest tonight and￥be ready for training tomorrow.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１７If you get too caught up in￥daily training, you can lose￥sight of what it's really for.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０１８Not that I'm worried about you￥on that front...＝＠１４７＿０１９I just wanted to check how￥confident you were.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０２１Fair enough.￥Maybe it is a bit late to ask.＝＠１４７＿０２２That's what you work so hard for￥every day, after all.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０２３I know the training's tough, but￥the final exam is almost here.＝＠１４７＿０２４Hang in there.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０２６You looked like you'd lost sight￥of why you're training, and￥you'd stopped improving.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿０２７But I guess I was worrying over￥nothing.＝＠１４７＿０２８The final exam is coming up￥soon. Give it your best.

＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿００１People have all kinds of names￥for this planet, Elan...＝＠１４８＿００２"Humanity's star of hope"...￥"The new frontier"...￥"Our second homeworld"...＝＠１４８＿００３But here's how I see it.＝＠１４８＿００４Elan is... the "new home" that￥humanity seeks, now that it's￥lost the home it came from.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿００５I've never lived on Earth, but￥for some reason...＝＠１４８＿００６When I look at Elan, it feels￥so familiar to me.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿００８The point is, that's how much￥humanity longs for Elan.＝＠１４８＿００９And you've still got the big￥final exam ahead of you.＝＠１４８＿０１０Don't let your guard down.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０１１You know, I was born the year￥Elan was discovered.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０１２Finding a planet just like Earth￥caused a huge stir back then.＝＠１４８＿０１３And as the years went by, it￥grew clearer and clearer that￥humanity could move there.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０１４Back then, settling on a planet￥felt like something in the far,￥far future...＝＠１４８＿０１５But now it's almost here.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０１６Yeah...￥For you candidates, it's a lot￥closer to home.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０１８I never got to be a candidate,￥but I'm rooting for all of you￥with everything I've got.＝＠１４８＿０１９The final exam is close now.￥Stay sharp and do your best.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０２０Good! That's the spirit.＝＠１４８＿０２１Elan is no fairy tale. It's real￥ground that people will walk on.＝＠１４８＿０２２Don't forget that.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０２３I see. You've got a good head on￥your shoulders, so maybe I￥didn't need to say it.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４８＿０２４Maybe someone in charge￥shouldn't be saying this, but...＝＠１４８＿０２５I hope you're the one￥who goes...
